organoid/complementarity-budget-summary..distance_definition: Same as evaluator version 3: native np.rint then clip to image-index bounds; ZYX spacing 1.625,0.40625,0.40625 um.
organoid/complementarity-budget-summary..rank_definition: One-based descending Organoid heatmap score within the complete frame, using stable sorting; scores are not calibrated probabilities.
organoid/complementarity-budget-summary..interpretation: Two-thirds of these selected gains survive the incumbent-sized candidate budget, supporting limited complementarity among relatively high-ranked Organoid candidates. One-third depends on lower-ranked candidates excluded by the cap. Organoid's full-panel recall remains substantially below incumbent recall at that same candidate count. A union or tracking improvement has not been tested.
caveats: This is a selected nine-case post-hoc diagnostic, not an independent validation set.
The cap is applied to Organoid alone. No union with incumbent detections was inferred, matched, or evaluated.
Detection matches do not demonstrate valid temporal links or a competition score improvement.
